【原视频简介】
We're back to visit our favorite 86 year old Japanese artisan, Nakamura Blacksmith! This time he is taking on the challenging Aogami Super steel to make a knife that his son says he doesn't have the skills to copy. We thought the knife came out beautiful! Let us know what you think about these hand made knives in the comments below!
